name: REI Co-op Mastercard

apr.notes: Purchase and transfer APR 17.49% to 28.49% variable; cash advance APR 28.49% variable.

fx_fee.notes: Capital One states that it doesn't charge foreign transaction fees on any of its U.S.-issued credit cards.

base_rate.description: 1.5% in card rewards on all other purchases.

categories.label: REI Co-op purchases at REI stores and REI.com, and donations to the REI Cooperative Action Fund

rewards.redemption_notes: Rewards can be redeemed as soon as they post and don't expire for the life of the account.

signup_bonus.description: $100 REI gift card after the first purchase outside of REI within 60 days of account opening.

notes: Available to REI Co-op members. The product page lists no annual fee and no foreign transaction fees. network_tier is recorded as none because the page does not name the Mastercard package.
